prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original painted UI MATERIAL SOURCE for the Rune Cast style pilot. Generate one seamless-looking square material swatch, not a screenshot and not a UI composition.
Primary request: a front-facing perfectly flat dark navy/indigo slate material surface with broad matte hand-painted polygonal chips, restrained fine cracks and simple angular brush-shaped facets. This will sit INSIDE a separate precisely drawn square gold tile frame. Strong stylized fantasy cartoon paint matching indigo stone in a lantern-lit crypt; substantial dark navy shadows with a few blue-gray planes, not glossy, not realistic stone.
Composition: edge-to-edge uninterrupted square navy material on a 1024 by 1024 opaque canvas. Material detail of medium-low contrast, darkest at the perimeter, calmer center for later text and glyph overlays. A few broad chips rather than dense gritty noise. Limit the palette to #152335, #1b2d45, #243c54, subdued #324a60 highlights.
Constraints: only the material surface, no icons, no glyphs, no lines suggesting circuit connections, no gold frame, no bevelled slab perimeter, no text, no numbers, no buttons, no background scene, no light bloom, no repeated motifs, no metal reflections. Original asset inspired by broad matte angular navy UI stone, not a crop from a reference.
reference_usage: Visual direction only, never sampled/cropped into the artwork. Text prompts for original material generation.
refinement: Fit original painted swatch to material polygon; retain separately editable painted material, dark silhouette, gold trim, highlight/shadow facets, bevel/rim and state geometry. Geometry is in build_materials.py and shared state SVGs.
source_limits: Generated swatch contains flattened painted strokes; individual strokes are not layers. Structural materials/trim/states are genuine independent layers, never duplicated composites.
rights_status: AI-generated pilot candidate. No third-party asset package acquired. No model version, exclusive ownership, licence clearance, shipping approval or device readiness inferred.
